verified_facts.text: The hotel has panoramic views of the city and the Old Town.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel location brags stunning, panoramic views of the city and the Old Town.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's views of Tbilisi overlook Narikala fortress and the Mtkvari River, with mountains around the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spectacular views of Tbilisi, surrounded by mountains, overlooking Narikala fortress and river Mtkvari.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is just minutes from Abanotubani, the ancient district of Tbilisi known for its sulphur baths.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are located just minutes from Abanotubani, the ancient district of Tbilisi, Georgia, known for its Sulphur Baths.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is just minutes from the Bridge of Peace, which connects Old Tbilisi with the new district.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are located just minutes from the Bridge of Peace, which stretches 150 meters (490 ft) over the Mtkvari River, creating a contemporary design feature connecting Old Tbilisi with the new district.

verified_facts.text: Metechi Bridge, at the foot of Narikala fort, is a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Metechi Bridge is located at the eastern bank of the Mtkvari River at the foot of Narikala fort across Metekhisubani, the historical part of Tbilisi, just 10 minutes walk from our hotel.

verified_facts.text: Old Tbilisi, Narikala Fortress, Rike Park and Sameba Trinity Cathedral are nearby.
verified_facts.excerpt: Old Tbilisi, Narikala Fortress, Rike Park, Sameba Trinity Cathedral, Mtskheta-Ancient Capital and more are nearby Sheraton Grand Tbilisi Metechi Palace.

verified_facts.text: The P'auza Spa facilities include an indoor pool, plunge pool, grotto, ice pool, steam room and sauna, plus a spacious relaxation area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy our indoor pool, plunge pool, grotto, ice pool, steam room, and sauna, as well as a spacious relaxation area.

verified_facts.text: P'auza Spa uses Germaine de Capuccini products in its face and body treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: we use premium Germaine de Capuccini products in our face and body treatments

verified_facts.text: The spa's Couple Luxury Suite experience pairs a couple's massage with time in a private jacuzzi with snacks and wine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a romantic escape in our Couple Luxury Suite, featuring a 50 minutes couple’s massage followed by 30 minute in a private jacuzzi with snacks and wine.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers couples massages, facials, in-suite massages and manicures and pedicures.

verified_facts.text: The spa's name refers to the Georgian saying that life is just a minute, inviting guests to pause from the rush of life.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tsutisopeli means life is just a minute. At p'auza, pause from the rush of life and nurture your wellbeing

verified_facts.text: The fitness center is complimentary for hotel guests and includes functional training rigs, squat racks and a boxing room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Functional training rigs, squat racks Boxing room

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a heated indoor pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in an indoor pool or outdoor heated pool.

verified_facts.text: Spa guests can stay after the Couple Luxury Suite experience to use the pools, saunas and fitness room for the rest of the day.
verified_facts.excerpt: you are welcome to stay and relax for the rest of the day, enjoying access to our pools, saunas, and fitness room
